en_title: The Wachowskis Move to Reclaim The Matrix Rights From Skydance
cn_title: 沃卓斯基姐妹着手从Skydance手中收回《黑客帝国》版权
opus_summary: 据The Puck Report报道，拉娜和莉莉·沃卓斯基已正式通知华纳兄弟，准备收回《黑客帝国》版权；若成功，版权将在2029年回归。华纳正在开发第五部电影，而其新母公司Skydance似乎有信心谈成新协议。

paragraphs.en: The future of The Matrix franchise is looking increasingly murky. According to The Puck Report , Lana and Lilly Wachowski have formally notified Warner Bros. of their move to reclaim the copyright to the iconic sci-fi franchise.
paragraphs.cn: 《黑客帝国》系列的未来看起来越来越不明朗。据The Puck Report报道，拉娜·沃卓斯基和莉莉·沃卓斯基已正式通知华纳兄弟，她们正着手收回这一标志性科幻系列的版权。

paragraphs.en: If successful, the Wachowskis would regain the rights to the series on the 30th anniversary of the original film's release in 2029. This move comes as the studio is developing a fifth The Matrix movie , with Drew Goddard attached to write and direct and Lana Wachowski herself executive producing. That project may give the Wachowskis extra leverage in their negotiations with Warners.
paragraphs.cn: 如果成功，沃卓斯基姐妹将在2029年首部电影上映30周年之际重新获得该系列的版权。她们采取这一行动之际，华纳兄弟正在开发第五部《黑客帝国》电影，由德鲁·戈达德编剧兼执导，拉娜·沃卓斯基本人担任执行制片人。这个项目可能会为沃卓斯基姐妹与华纳的谈判增加筹码。

paragraphs.en: Will this derail development on The Matrix 5? Not necessarily. The site also notes that WB's new parent company Skydance seems confident in its ability to negotiate a new deal, building on previous successes renegotiating the copyright for The Godfather and acquiring The Terminator rights in 2011. The Puck Report also alludes to a potential legal hurdle on the Wachowskis' side, as it could be argued that the original The Matrix screenplay was part of a work-for-hire arrangement with Warner Bros. back in the '90s.
paragraphs.cn: 这会打乱《黑客帝国5》的开发吗？不一定。该网站还指出，华纳兄弟的新母公司Skydance似乎有信心谈成一项新协议，此前该公司曾成功重新谈判《教父》的版权，并于2011年获得《终结者》的版权。The Puck Report还提到了沃卓斯基姐妹可能面临的一项法律障碍：有人可能会提出，最初的《黑客帝国》剧本是她们在上世纪90年代与华纳兄弟签订的雇佣创作协议的一部分。

paragraphs.en: All of this may suggest that the more likely outcome is that the Wachowskis negotiate a new, more lucrative deal and Skydance retains the rights to The Matrix for the foreseeable future. Despite Lilly Wachowski publicly distancing herself from the property , The Puck Report writes, "From what I hear, the sisters have been encouraging of the newest sequel and have even increased their involvement lately."
paragraphs.cn: 这一切或许表明，更有可能的结果是沃卓斯基姐妹谈成一项收益更丰厚的新协议，而Skydance在可预见的未来继续保有《黑客帝国》的版权。尽管莉莉·沃卓斯基公开与该系列保持距离，The Puck Report写道：「据我所知，这对姐妹一直支持最新的续集，最近甚至加深了参与程度。」

paragraphs.en: Little is currently known about The Matrix 5 beyond Goddard's involvement. There's currently no release date, nor is it clear whether series stars Keanu Reeves and Carrie-Anne Moss will return or if the focus will shift to a new cast of cyberpunk martial artists. But the studio seems to have high hopes for the sequel, despite its predecessor, 2021's The Matrix Resurrections, proving to be a box office dud. It certainly didn't help that the film debuted during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic and premiered on HBO Max the same day as it did in theaters, prompting a lawsuit from Village Roadshow .
paragraphs.cn: 除了戈达德参与其中，目前外界对《黑客帝国5》知之甚少。影片目前尚未确定上映日期，系列主演基努·里维斯和凯瑞-安·莫斯是否会回归，还是焦点会转向一批新的赛博朋克武术角色，也尚不清楚。但片方似乎对这部续集寄予厚望，尽管前作、2021年的《黑客帝国：矩阵重启》最终票房惨淡。这部电影在新冠疫情最严重时期上映，并在院线上映当天同步登陆HBO Max，显然也无助于其表现，还因此招致Village Roadshow提起诉讼。
